publications.name: An Inverse Result for Ruzsa's Inequality on Triple Sumsets
publications.summary: We prove an inverse result which says that if |A+A+A| is close to its lower bound, then the set A resembles the sets in Ruzsa's construction. We also provide a 99%-stability version of Ruzsa's inequality.
